evaluation_contract: Structural and negative scenario assertions require fresh blind prediction; no target workflow execution is implied.

evals.name: dated-eligibility
evals.prompt: My device runs a later OS than the dated reference. Is every listed Apple Intelligence feature available?
evals.expected_output: Use the product reference with its date; separate documentation from device-tested behavior and name the unverified version gap.

assertions.name: dated-eligibility-1
assertions.check: Does not upgrade a dated statement into confirmed current device behavior.

assertions.name: dated-eligibility-2
assertions.check: Names the relevant dated reference or the missing coverage.

evals.name: app-intents
evals.prompt: Which reference should I consult before testing AppEntity content transfer and Siri integration?
evals.expected_output: Select the App Intents or cross-app content transfer reference and preserve its documented boundaries.

assertions.name: app-intents-1
assertions.check: Selects the narrow matching reference rather than unrelated creative features.

assertions.name: app-intents-2
assertions.check: Does not claim a local SDK test was run.

evals.name: wrong-domain
evals.prompt: Use these Apple Intelligence notes to train an MLX-LM LoRA adapter.

assertions.name: wrong-domain-1
assertions.check: Routes the request to the named MLX-LM peer.

assertions.name: wrong-domain-2
assertions.check: Does not invent training advice from Apple product-feature notes.
